Phase: web app hierarchy structure-aware reconcile extension
Business goal: Apply an approved structure-aware reconcile result so curated hierarchy truth becomes synchronized with current discovered app structure.
User outcome: A privileged root operator can intentionally create or reuse curated modules pages and page locators from discovered structure truth, then have `GetTree` reflect the synchronized curated hierarchy.
Notes / constraints: Apply must preserve backwards compatibility by default. It should create or reuse curated modules and pages, create or refresh one active page locator per page, write explicit discovery-link rows, and never silently delete curated nodes because discovery changed. Metadata drift should be reported, not blindly overwritten, unless the approved apply posture says a specific field is safe to refresh.
Tenant context rule: root-operated hierarchy capability outside tenant-scoped authorization; no tenant context applies
Explicitly denied roles: tenant actors; unauthenticated callers; authenticated root users without the governing capability
Authorization summary: Only privileged root operators may apply structure-aware reconcile.
Authz scope type: root-scoped sync apply over an approved preview scope
Frontend visibility rule: No frontend surface is required in the first backend reconcile slice although later root-admin tooling should consume this apply seam after preview.
Backend enforcement rule: Root auth and root authorization must run before apply. The feature must validate scope, validate preview assumptions if a preview token or exact discovered ids are supplied, then mutate curated modules pages active page locators and discovery-link rows safely and deterministically.
Session / expiry behavior: Uses existing authenticated root-session expiry rules. No tenant session behavior applies.
Client-side permission behavior: No client-side behavior in this loop.

Response contract: Returns apply summary with created or reused modules created or reused pages created or refreshed page locators created or refreshed discovery links blocked items drift items and the updated curated hierarchy tree or tree reference."
Error contract: 400 invalid scope or invalid apply flags; 401 unauthenticated; 403 unauthorized; 404 referenced preview/discovery/hierarchy record not found; 409 ambiguous match locator conflict duplicate active locator or compatibility blocker for a live curated page.
Cross-feature seams: Consumes structure-aware discovery reads from `webAppSurfaceDiscovery`; writes durable link truth inside `webAppHierarchyBuilder`; later convenience sync may chain this after preview.
Persistence impact: Creates and updates durable `webAppPageLocator` records and durable discovery-link records in addition to curated module/page rows. Existing page rows remain durable and should not be destroyed automatically.
Indexes / uniqueness: Unique active locator per page. Unique active normalized locator key. Unique active discovery link per discovered structure node. Indexes on drift status match status discovered ids and curated ids.
Search / filter model: Apply by explicit approved preview scope or selected discovered ids only. No broad fuzzy mutation surface in the first slice.
Compatibility / migration notes: This capability likely requires a careful migration because current pages are path-segment-shaped. Hash-state pages must be represented through the locator seam rather than overloaded path fields. Existing `GetTree` consumers need a compatibility strategy while locator truth moves into a child seam.
Authorization enforcement layer: Root auth middleware plus root authorization enforcement and feature-local apply validation and conflict detection.
CSP / browser security impact: No direct browser impact in API-only slice. Future root-admin apply UI must consume governed preview/apply surfaces.
Audit requirement: Audit successful applies and denied attempts with actor rootUserId scope created counts reused counts blocked counts and drift summaries.

Acceptance notes: Capability is acceptable when an operator can intentionally apply a structure-aware reconcile that creates or reuses curated modules pages and locators honestly, writes explicit links, and updates `GetTree` without silent destructive behavior.
